name: The Altar of Zul
summary: At the Altar of Zul, Talonaxe's search for Sharpbeak reaches the Vilebranch lands. Witherbark has no sign of the young gryphon, and Talonaxe fears the Vilebranch may hold him.

sections.title: Another Tribe, Another Search
sections.body: With no sign of Sharpbeak in the Witherbark cages, Gryphon Master Talonaxe suspects the Vilebranch trolls took him. So he sends you to search the top of the Altar of Zul, at the western edge of their lands. If they hold the gryphon child, Talonaxe fears what they may be doing to him.

sections.title: Word From the Altar
sections.body: Sharpbeak is not at the altar. Talonaxe calls that bad news, but good as well. The Vilebranch are known to carry out sacrifices, and he is relieved the gryphon was not found there. He thanks you for your aid and says a greater undertaking lies ahead.

faq.q: Why does Gryphon Master Talonaxe send you to the Altar of Zul?
aliases: why go to altar of zul
faq.answer: The Witherbark trolls do not have Sharpbeak, so Talonaxe suspects the Vilebranch may have taken him.

faq.q: Where is the Altar of Zul located?
faq.answer: The Altar of Zul lies at the western edge of Vilebranch lands in the Hinterlands. You are to search its top.
Sharpbeak is Swiftwing's heir, the gryphon child Talonaxe has searched for since he went missing.

faq.q: Why is Talonaxe worried about the Vilebranch trolls?
faq.answer: Talonaxe fears what the Vilebranch trolls may be doing to Sharpbeak if they hold him.
